name: Stegosaurus

features.claim: It had a double row of kite-shaped plates standing upright along its rounded back.
features.quote: the distinctive double row of kite-shaped plates rising vertically along the rounded back

features.claim: It had two pairs of long spikes near the end of its tail.
features.quote: the two pairs of long spikes extending horizontally near the end of the tail
The quadrupedal Stegosaurus is one of the most easily identifiable dinosaur genera

features.claim: It was heavily built, with a rounded back, short front legs and long back legs.
features.quote: They were large, heavily built, herbivorous quadrupeds with rounded backs, short fore limbs, long hind limbs, and tails held high in the air.

features.claim: It had a short neck and a small head.
features.quote: It had a short neck and a small head, meaning it most likely ate low-lying bushes and shrubs.

features.claim: Its plates stood upright, alternating on either side of the spine.
features.quote: Marsh realised that they stood vertically, alternately on either side of the spine.

not_this.claim: It is wrong to draw the plates lying flat on its back like roof tiles.
not_this.quote: When O C Marsh described the first fossil of a Stegosaurus, he concluded that the plates would have lain flat on its back.

not_this.claim: It is wrong to draw the plates lying flat, because they actually stood on edge.
not_this.quote: As further and complete plates were found, their form showed they stood on edge, rather than lying flat.

debated.claim: The way the plates were arranged on the back has been argued about for a long time.
debated.quote: One of the major subjects of books and articles about Stegosaurus is the plate arrangement.

quote_not_in_the_page.claim: Its skull was long and narrow.
quote_not_in_the_page.quote: The skull of Stegosaurus was long and narrow.

quote_not_in_the_page.claim: It had no front teeth but had a beak covered in horn.
quote_not_in_the_page.quote: It had no front teeth, but it did have a horn-covered beak.

quote_not_in_the_page.claim: Its back legs each had three toes and its front legs had five.
quote_not_in_the_page.quote: The back legs each had three short toes, while the front legs had five toes.
